pattern: uses workflow_loop_put to add a feedback loop instead of rewriting the whole workflow
experience: Asked to add a review-to-draft feedback loop with maxRounds 3, the agent calls workflow_loop_put rather than workflow_save or workflow_delete.
rule: Add or update a bounded loop-back connection in a saved T3 workflow in .t3/workflows.

priorTurns.text: Show me the release-audit workflow in project proj_1.
The release-audit workflow has two steps: draft -> review.

prompt: Add a loop from review back to draft on the release-audit workflow in project proj_1 so review can send draft back for revision up to 3 rounds until the review step says pass.

pattern: uses workflow_loop_delete to remove a loop by id
experience: Asked to remove the review-to-draft loop from a workflow, the agent calls workflow_loop_delete with the loopId.
rule: Remove a loop-back connection from a saved T3 workflow in .t3/workflows.
prompt: Remove the loop with id review-to-draft from the release-audit workflow in project proj_1.

pattern: loop-exit step reports VERDICT: revise and echoes executionToken without setting failed: true
experience: When a loop-exit review step finds an issue that requires another round, it passes executionToken and ends summary with VERDICT: revise: <reason> while keeping failed: false.
